title: HPA: dengue, respiratory and gut illnesses up sharply in January
detail: The Health Protection Agency reported 647 dengue cases in January 2026 (424 a year earlier), plus 34,840 acute respiratory infections and 7,792 gastroenteritis cases; Vaavu atoll had the highest dengue rate.

title: Speedboat and supply vessel collide near Male'; vessel leaves scene
detail: Police said a speedboat collided with a supply vessel near Male' early on 1 June, injuring two crew; the supply vessel left without waiting and is being investigated separately.

title: Apartment fire in Male' sends 28 for treatment
detail: MNDF fire and rescue put out a fourth-floor residential fire on Lonuziyaaraiy Magu by midnight; 28 people were treated, with no deaths reported.

title: MET White Alert for northern and central atolls, rough seas
detail: The Maldives Meteorological Service issued a White Alert for HA. Atoll through Faafu Atoll, forecasting gusts to 40 mph, rough seas and heavy rain through the weekend.

title: Gas cylinder blast in Male' house injures four, 41 evacuated
detail: A gas cylinder exploded at a house in Male', burning four people (two in intensive care) and damaging an adjacent building; NDMA said 41 people were evacuated and given shelter.

title: Foreign Currency Act amendment ratified to curb black-market dollar trade
detail: President Muizzu ratified an amendment, effective 1 September, requiring businesses to convert 40% of foreign-currency earnings through MMA-licensed banks and limiting dollar trades to MMA-set rates; fines for individuals range from MVR 25,000 to MVR 1 million.

title: Heavy rain floods over 70 homes in Feydhoo, Addu City
detail: NDMA and MNDF responded after heavy rain flooded more than 70 houses in Feydhoo and two in Maradhoo; one household of eight was moved to a shelter, and more rain was forecast for southern and central atolls.

title: Two expatriates detained in black-market dollar trading crackdown
detail: Police and Immigration detained two Bangladeshi nationals on 12 and 14 September for unauthorised dollar trading; police said six expatriates held earlier had moved MVR 54.4 million and USD 1.6 million through their accounts over three years.

title: NDMA aids southern atolls after flood damage; 7 Feydhoo homes uninhabitable
detail: NDMA said about 80 houses flooded in Feydhoo, seven left uninhabitable, with sewerage and service disruption in Gaafu Alif, Gaafu Dhaalu, Fuvahmulah and Addu; it began cleaning, damage assessments and relocations.
prov: Gaafu Alif, Gaafu Dhaalu, Fuvahmulah, Addu

title: Coast Guard detains foreign vessel fishing illegally in EEZ
detail: MNDF Coast Guard said it intercepted a foreign fishing vessel with six people aboard about 124 nautical miles from K. Dhiffushi for unauthorised fishing in the EEZ; nationality not disclosed.

title: Power outage hits parts of Male' and Hulhumale'
detail: STELCO reported an electricity outage affecting Hulhumale' Phase 1 and the Henveiru, Machchangoalhi and Maafannu districts of Male'; the cause was under investigation.

title: Customs seize 3.34 kg of cannabis at Gan airport
detail: Maldives Customs said it found 3.34 kg of suspected cannabis in the luggage of two Indian men arriving from India at Gan International Airport; both were handed to police.

title: Police: 1,584 scams reported so far in 2026, over MVR 15m lost
detail: The Maldives Police Service Anti-Scam Centre reported 1,584 scam cases year-to-date with losses over MVR 15 million (MVR 6.6 million recovered); 2,803 accounts were frozen for 48 hours, 530 frozen for three more months by court order, and 53 suspects arrested. Fake online businesses (821) and currency-exchange fraud (240) led.
